GET.summary: Get the keys that moved the most estimated bytes in the last completed window, ordered by estimated bytes per second descending
GET.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys in the traffic history

reply_schema.description: Keys that moved the most estimated bytes in the last completed window, ordered by estimated bytes per second (descending)

bytes_per_second.description: Estimated bytes per second moved by this key over the last completed window (sampled; reads and whole-value writes)
